text:
Sorry about the mix-up. Once an order has shipped, we can't change its shipping address, and couriers don't accept redirection requests from Leafy, so I can't redirect this one. Shipped orders also can't be cancelled.

Express also won't work for your dad: it isn't available to island addresses (Zone 3). Standard is the only option there, at 5-8 business days, and it's $7.95 or free on orders of $75+. Live plants ship Monday-Wednesday only, so an order placed after 12 noon Wednesday ships the following Monday.

Our policy doesn't cover what to do with a parcel that's already out for delivery to an address you're leaving, so I can't advise on that. I can escalate your case to a Support Lead if you'd like someone to look at it. Would you like me to do that?
